_provenance: grid supply pathways design note, Aug 2026 (colleague's design, external to this repository). Values are quoted verbatim from the note's data appendix and are NOT re-derived, adjusted or improved here.

policy_frontier_derived._note: The note states these as derived quantities. Verified internally consistent: 0.1867 / (1 - 0.796) = 0.915196, and 0.915196 / 0.1867 = 4.902 = 1 / (1 - 0.796). The ratio is a function of the renewable share alone; no emissions datum enters it.

block_structure._source: design note, proposed extension. Three segments per pathway.

marginal_firmed_renewables.cost_basis: planned cost plus an escalating adder
